excluded.GODOT-OTHER-IDENTIFIER-CASE: Every kind this rule is assigned to already has a kind-specific snake_case rule as a core rule, so this duplicate rule is excluded to avoid duplicate targets for the gate and for violation injection.
excluded.GODOT-PARAM-INPUT-PREFIX: Applies only to method parameters that are not used to return a value, but the gate cannot separate this condition using the kind parameter alone. Requiring p_ on every parameter would reject names that correctly use r_.
excluded.GODOT-PARAM-OUTPUT-PREFIX: Applies only to method parameters that are used to return a value, but the gate cannot separate this condition using the kind parameter alone. Requiring r_ on every parameter would reject names that correctly use p_.
excluded.GODOT-IDENTIFIER-FULL-WORDS: Has no mechanically checkable attribute, and deciding whether a name is a full word depends on the meaning of the name.
excluded.GODOT-IDENTIFIER-ABBREVIATION-LIMIT: Has no mechanically checkable attribute, and the exception for readability depends on context; it cannot be replaced by a fixed forbidden-word list drawn from this document.
